versions.content: function KeyExists [SWS_PER_00043] Upstream: RS_PER_00003 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < bool > KeyExists ( ara::core::StringView key) const noexcept; Checks if a key-value pair exists in this Key-Value Storage. The result is only accurate if no key-value pair is added or deleted at the same time. E.g. when a key-value pair is removed in another thread directly after this function returned "true", the result is not valid anymore. This method uses transaction semantics, it sees the current state of transaction, not the actual physical storage.
